run_explorer_grid: run the explorer function to launch a grid of htdemucs and hdemucs training experiments on SLURM
configure_htdemucs_experiment: configure an htdemucs experiment with 4 depth, 5 transformer layers, and 0.02 dropout via launcher.bind_
launch_sparse_attention_experiment: launch a sparse attention experiment with auto sparsity, sparse self and cross attention at 0.9 sparsity
submit_job_array: submit a job array of experiments iterating over transformer layers and bottom channels with varying segment durations
review_explorer_function: review the explorer function to understand how SLURM jobs are configured with 8 GPUs and a 3-day time limit
